items.title: How Icelanders are thinking about AI
items.description:
In late 2025, Iceland’s government launched one of the world’s first national AI education pilots, giving teachers who volunteered access to AI tools.

We visited Iceland to find out how people are thinking about AI.

items.title: Tasks that require whole-body control with Gemini Robotics 2
items.description:
The world is built for human movements; it requires us to reach, bend, and balance in tight, cluttered spaces. While our previous models controlled the humanoid’s upper-body to achieve table-top tasks, Gemini Robotics 2 expands physical AI into whole-body motions. 

Learn more about Gemini for Robot

items.description:
